summary: The three compositions, compact navigation, readable body, fit-content context and restrained borders are suitable for comparison. Permission scope and rejection consequences are visible. Two material fixes remain: C keyboard focus and meaningful Composer child-state affordances.

open_findings.title: C textarea loses all keyboard focus indication
open_findings.observed: Actual Tab focus is focus-visible, but textarea outline:none!important and C composer outline:0 remove every visible focus indicator.
open_findings.correction: Add token-based 2px focus indication to actual C input area; keep the resting shelf borderless.

open_findings.title: Composer state specimens retain incorrect child affordances
open_findings.observed: Sending/unknown/stale Send is active; stopping Stop is active; running/stopping context selectors are active; archived textarea is editable; error changes borderColor on an element without a border while ::before remains default gray.
open_findings.correction: Apply meaningful states to textarea, Send/Stop, context, actual pseudo-edge and associated reason/message. Separate input/sendStop specimens do not satisfy Composer states.
